prompt: Ми думаємо про оновлення zod до 4-ї мажорної версії. Перед тим як це робити, хочу переконатися що немає розбіжностей версій між server/client/reviewer-core/mcp, і які ще залежності в нас застарілі настільки що варто звернути увагу.
expectations: reports_actual_installed_zod_version_per_package — gives the real resolved zod version in each of server/client/reviewer-core/mcp (from node_modules), not just the declared package.json range
does_not_falsely_claim_drift — ground truth is that all 4 packages currently resolve to the same zod major/version; the answer must not claim there IS a version conflict/drift when there isn't one

separately_notes_declared_range_difference — if it notices mcp declares a different semver range (^3.25.0 vs ^3.24.1 elsewhere) it flags this as a minor/cosmetic note, not as if it were already causing a problem

covers_other_outdated_majors_beyond_zod — the answer also surfaces at least one other significant outdated major dependency (e.g. typescript, vitest, openai, next), since the user asked for that too, not just a zod-only answer
